headlines.title: 资本市场支持房地产新政落地 多措并举满足房企合理融资需求
headlines.summary: 【资本市场支持房地产新政落地 多措并举满足房企合理融资需求】中国证监会8月28日发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》。作为资本市场涉房地产各项融资业务的指引性文件，《意见》着力改革完善房地产企业股票、债券、资产支持证券（ABS）和不动产投资信托基金（REITs）等融资制度，满足房地产企业合理融资需求，助力构建房地产发展新模式。业内人士看来，随着《意见》与商业不动产REITs试点协同推进，资本市场支持房地产发展新模式的制度框架初步成形。

headlines.title_en: Capital market supportive policies for real estate implemented, multiple measures to meet reasonable financing needs of developers
headlines.summary_en: [Capital market support for new real estate policies implemented; multiple measures to meet reasonable financing needs of developers] The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) released the "Opinions on Capital Market Support for Building a New Model for Real Estate Development" on August 28. As a guiding document for real estate-related financing activities in the capital market, the Opinions focus on reforming and improving financing systems for real estate companies, including stocks, bonds, asset-backed securities (ABS) and real estate investment trusts (REITs), to meet the reasonable financing needs of developers and help build a new model for real estate development. Industry insiders believe that with the coordinated advancement of the Opinions and the commercial real estate REITs pilot, the institutional framework for capital market support of the new real estate development model is taking initial shape.

headlines.title: 8月28日杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会要点总结
headlines.summary: 1、美联储主席凯文·沃什的主旨演讲传递了鹰派信号。他表示，今夏好于预期的通胀报告“并不能说明潜在趋势已出现有意义的改善”。除非美联储确信潜在通胀正”以清晰、足够快的速度”朝着目标迈进，否则“我们还有工作要做”，他说。 2、7月份，沃什似乎为转向另一个（可能涨幅更低的）物价指标打开了大门，但此次他明确表示，美联储2%的目标“以个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数衡量，是一个坚定、固定的目标”。

headlines.title_en: Key takeaways from the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium on August 28
headlines.summary_en: 1. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote speech conveyed a hawkish signal. He said this summer's better-than-expected inflation reports "do not indicate a meaningful improvement in the underlying trend." Unless the Fed is confident underlying inflation is moving toward its target "clearly and quickly enough," "we still have work to do," he said. 2. In July, Warsh appeared to open the door to switching to another (possibly lower-inflation) price gauge, but this time he made clear the Fed's 2% target "as measured by the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index is a firm, fixed target."

headlines.title: 专家：现房销售更强调“所见即所得”，契合存量房时代运行逻辑
headlines.summary: 浙江工业大学中国住房和房地产研究院院长虞晓芬介绍，现房销售，则更强调“所见即所得”，契合存量房时代运行逻辑。过去数十年我国住房供需缺口大，预售制度充分发挥了加速住房供给、快速回笼资金的优势，有效缓解了城镇化快速推进阶段的住房供给短缺矛盾，适配了行业高速发展需求。但当前我国住房市场格局已发生根本性转变，城镇居民人均住房建筑面积已超过40平方米，存量市场、增量市场供给充足，二手房销售面积占比过半，房地产发展目标需要从规模转向质量，市场主要矛盾已从“有没有”转向“好不好”，行业发展逻辑彻底重构。国家推进现房销售，是顺应市场的演化趋势，适配供求关系发生重大变化的

headlines.title_en: Experts: Presale of completed homes emphasizes 'what you see is what you get,' aligning with the logic of the existing-home era
headlines.summary_en: Yu Xiaofen, dean of Zhejiang University of Technology's China Housing and Real Estate Research Institute, said that presale (forward) sales emphasize "what you see is what you get," fitting the logic of the era of the existing-home stock market. Over the past decades, China's housing supply-demand gap was large, and the presale system fully leveraged advantages in accelerating housing supply and quickly recovering funds, effectively alleviating the housing supply shortage during rapid urbanization and adapting to the industry's high-speed development needs. But current housing market conditions have fundamentally changed: per-capita urban housing floor area has exceeded 40 square meters, supply is ample in both existing and incremental markets, second-hand home sales account for over half of transactions, and the development goal needs to shift from scale to quality. The main market contradiction has moved from "having or not" to "good or not," and the industry's development logic has been thoroughly restructured. The state's push for presale (completed-home) sales follows market evolution trends and adapts to major changes in supply-demand relations.

headlines.title: 工行副行长：预计零售、普惠贷款的资产质量也将保持在合理、可控的区间

headlines.title_en: ICBC Vice President: Asset quality of retail and inclusive loans expected to remain within reasonable, controllable range
headlines.summary_en: Wang Jingwu, vice president of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), said at the bank's 2026 interim results conference that ICBC adheres to steady progress with quality and efficiency improvements, closely follows national strategies, makes full-asset allocations, optimizes credit structure, and solidly advances asset quality controls. The group's core asset quality indicators remained stable and improved, with the non-performing loan (NPL) ratio at 1.29% at end-June 2026, down 2 basis points from the start of the year, further consolidating the foundation for high-quality development.

headlines.title_en: Two-year U.S. Treasury yield rises over 11 basis points on Friday, investor rate-hike expectations firm after Waller's hawkish signal
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 28) New York close: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.18 bps to 4.7180%. When Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech text was released, it fell to 4.6485%, a daily low, then saw a prolonged tail-end W-shaped rebound. It fell 1.59 bps for the week, overall in a declining state with a wide-bottom U-shaped pattern. The 2-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 11.14 bps to 4.3434%. Sixty seconds before Warsh's speech text was released, it fell to 4.2135%, a daily low, then rose steadily. It rose 10.75 bps for the week, with Warsh's speech disrupting the earlier stable state around the 4.2% level.

headlines.summary: 【三部门发文规范上市公司限售股个税 健全资本市场税收体系】8月28日，财政部、税务总局、中国证监会联合发布《关于规范转让上市公司限售股个人所得税政策的公告》，对个人转让上市公司限售股的个人所得税征管规则进行系统性优化。公告明确，个人转让上市公司限售股取得的所得，按照“财产转让所得”项目适用20%的比例税率缴纳个人所得税。

headlines.title_en: Three departments issue rules on individual income tax for restricted shares of listed firms, improving capital market tax system
headlines.summary_en: [Three departments issue rules on individual income tax for restricted shares of listed companies to improve capital market tax system] On August 28, the Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration, and the CSRC jointly issued the "Announcement on Regulating Individual Income Tax Policies for Transfers of Restricted Shares of Listed Companies," systematically optimizing the individual income tax collection rules for individuals transferring restricted shares of listed companies. The announcement clarifies that income derived by individuals from transferring restricted shares of listed companies is subject to individual income tax at a flat rate of 20% under the "income from transfer of property" category.

headlines.summary: 金十数据8月29日讯，中金指出，美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话态度偏鹰：他承认通胀仍然偏高、明确利率仍是主要政策工具，并表态将“视情况需要采取行动”；同时以经济韧性、就业稳定、金融条件宽松为依据，说明当前政策风险更偏通胀一侧。他还将65个月通胀超标的责任归于央行自身，纠正了7月“让市场代替美联储加息”的模糊表态。中金认为，这次讲话有助于重建美联储的公信力，讲话过后，市场也开始交易政策信誉的边际修复。长期层面，沃什仍坚持AI可能重塑经济与政策框架，并继续推动减少前瞻指引等改革议程。对市场而言，本次表态提升了美联储年内加息概率，但即便如此，也未必是纯粹利空

headlines.title_en: CICC comments on Jackson Hole meeting: Late hawkish shift, a repair of credibility
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 29: CICC noted that Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech leaned hawkish: he acknowledged inflation remains elevated, made clear that rates remain the primary policy tool, and said the Fed will "act as circumstances warrant"; while citing economic resilience, stable employment and loose financial conditions to explain that current policy risks are skewed to the inflation side. He also attributed the 65-month inflation overshoot to the central bank itself, correcting July's vague "let the market replace the Fed in raising rates" stance. CICC believes the speech helps rebuild the Fed's credibility, and after the speech the market began pricing a marginal repair of policy credibility. On the longer term, Warsh still insists AI could reshape the economy and policy framework, and continues to push reforms such as reducing forward guidance. For the market, the remarks raised the probability of a Fed rate hike this year, but even so, it may not be purely negative.

headlines.title_en: Spot gold falls about 3.1%, Waller's remarks lean hawkish
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 28) New York close: Spot gold fell 3.08% to $4,457.57/oz. When Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech text was released at 22:00 Beijing time, it briefly rose to $4,631.61/oz, a daily high, then broke the prolonged high-level narrow range and fell rapidly. It fell 3.22% for the week, having traded in a narrow range from Monday until Warsh's speech, forming an intra-period top. Spot silver fell 4.17% to $66.3390/oz, down 3.89% for the week. COMEX copper futures fell 0.84% to $6.6330/lb, down 0.73% for the week.

headlines.title: 沃什杰克逊霍尔首秀偏鹰：通胀仍居首位 主张让美联储“更安静”
headlines.summary: 【沃什杰克逊霍尔首秀偏鹰：通胀仍居首位 主张让美联储“更安静”】当地时间8月28日，美联储主席凯文·沃什（KevinWarsh）在怀俄明州杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会上发表讲话。面对仍高于目标的通胀，沃什明确表示，美联储当前的首要任务仍然是价格稳定，并为未来数月进一步加息保留空间。“通胀仍然高于我们2%的目标，因此，美联储当前的主要关注点应该放在价格上。”沃什表示。尽管今年夏季公布的PCE和CPI数据好于预期，但“这些数据并没有告诉我，基础通胀趋势已经出现实质性改善”。

headlines.title_en: Waller's Jackson Hole debut leans hawkish: Inflation remains top priority, advocates a 'quieter' Fed
headlines.summary_en: [Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole debut: inflation remains top priority, advocates making the Fed 'quieter'] On August 28 local time, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium in Wyoming. Facing inflation still above target, Warsh made clear that the Fed's current top priority remains price stability, while leaving room for further rate hikes in the coming months. "Inflation is still above our 2% target, so the Fed's main focus right now should be on prices," Warsh said. Although PCE and CPI data released this summer beat expectations, "these data don't tell me that the underlying inflation trend has shown substantial improvement."

headlines.title: 顺丰控股：加快推进智能装备和AI应用场景落地
headlines.summary: 顺丰控股8月28日在业绩说明会表示，展望2026下半年，国内端，公司将继续深挖消费多元细分场景，深度服务B端企业转型升级，持续加深经营护城河；国际端，公司会紧抓中国企业品牌和产能出海机遇，加快发展第二增长曲线业务；同时，加快推进智能装备和AI应用场景落地，将技术优势转化为长期经营效益。综合来看，下半年外部环境仍存在油价等多重不确定性，公司将保持经营策略定力，持续精益管理，致力于交付稳健的营收和利润结果。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: SF Holding: Accelerating deployment of smart equipment and AI application scenarios
headlines.summary_en: SF Holding said at an earnings call on August 28 that looking ahead to the second half of 2026, domestically the company will continue exploring diversified consumption segments, deeply serve B-end enterprise transformation and upgrading, and further deepen its operational moat; internationally, it will seize opportunities from Chinese companies' brand and capacity going global, accelerate development of its second growth curve business; meanwhile, it will accelerate implementation of smart equipment and AI application scenarios, converting technological advantages into long-term operational benefits. Overall, external conditions in the second half still contain multiple uncertainties such as oil prices, and the company will maintain strategic focus, continue lean management, and commit to delivering steady revenue and profit results. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: September adjustment of Stock Connect eligible stocks nears, caution against speculation on 'inclusion' concept stocks
headlines.summary_en: September adjustments to the Stock Connect eligible lists are approaching, and the new inclusion lists have become a market focus. Industry experts remind that as the effective date of the Stock Connect adjustment nears, investors need to be highly alert to the risk of "flash crashes upon inclusion." Particular attention should be paid to stocks with weak fundamentals and highly concentrated shareholding; meanwhile, southbound funds and passive fund products should also take appropriate risk prevention measures. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: Maximum term for individual mortgages extended to 40 years! Experts: Monthly burden could drop by over 600 yuan under such conditions
headlines.summary_en: [Personal mortgage term extended to up to 40 years! Experts: Under such conditions, monthly burden drops by over 600 yuan] Extending the personal housing loan term from 30 years to 40 years is the most-discussed change in this round of policies. Yan Yuejin, deputy director of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute, said in an interview with Xinmin Evening News that using a 1 million yuan loan principal, 3% annual rate, and equal principal and interest repayment method: the 30-year monthly payment is 4,216.04 yuan, and after extending to 40 years the monthly payment drops to 3,581.02 yuan, reducing monthly payments by 635.02 yuan directly, a decline of about 15%.
